reviews.title: Returned twice but working in the end
reviews.comment:
I'll get this out of the way by saying that after returning this product, I bought another from somewhere else and it seems to be running fine, but my experience with the two I bought from Best Buy was terrible. 

The first one I purchased had the cable and bracket bags ripped open, which caused me to exchange the product for another one. After installing the exchanged one, it worked great for a bit, but after restarting my computer the LCD screen just died. I heard the USB disconnect sound and the LCD was just black with nothing I did reviving it. After getting my final replacement, it works great, but I noticed that the outer ring of LEDs seems to heat up the sensor for the liquid temperature, which can be annoying to account for when making fan curves.

The performance of the cooler is fine and does its job well, but if you're getting it for the LCD, just be mindful that there could be issues.
reviews.author: GunnarL
